notes: The 2015 code uses whole eggs, with free text source = eagle, because eagle was not a source. Eggs from birds not separately listed now exists, and Kites, Hawks and Eagles is the source. That family also includes kites and hawks, so eagle eggs cannot be reconstructed from the code and stays as free text. Other is not added: the base is already the group for birds without their own egg term.

The 2015 code uses the general flour group plus Other, because quinoa flour was not listed. Cereal and cereal-like flours not separately listed now exists, so the flour is coded there, with quinoa grain as the source commodity. Other is not added: the base is already the group for flours without their own term.
The 2015 code names the animal because kangaroo meat was not a commodity. Kangaroo fresh meat now exists, so the dried meat is coded from that commodity.

The 2015 code uses free text, source raw commodity = pelican egg, because pelican was not a source. Pelican egg still does not exist as a commodity. Pelicans is the family, and Pelecanus is the only genus under it, so the source is the genus.
